changes.summary: One press of Enter no longer both switches tabs and fires the tab's own action
A fast second Enter in the craft dialog no longer leaves it on screen without its overlay
Enter no longer takes all when hotkeys are turned off in settings
K opens a craft dialog listing every known recipe grouped by type, navigated by the arrow keys, with a Craft button in the bag tab beside it
I jumps to the bag and opens manage inventory; P jumps to the map
The scavenged percentage and the items list join the resources list in one row above the minimap, next to the thumb that does the scavenging
The room name in the top bar is now just the room name
The installed app no longer comes to rest with its top bar behind the status bar after the view moves without a resize
The room name now sits in the top bar in capitals with the scavenged percentage beside it, and the resources list has its own row above the minimap
Tapping a log card marks that message as read, so the unread count stops counting it
The room description and the map's sector details close on a tap anywhere instead of a close button, and tapping another sector shows that one
A tab can no longer end up on a full-width row of its own
The status bar reserve now measures from the smallest portrait viewport of the session, so a first frame that reports the whole screen cannot quietly switch it off
On a phone held sideways, the sector description now floats over the map instead of being squeezed into a narrow column beside it, and the map controls take only the width they need
The first message of the game now gets a card, like every other message, and cards stay visible while you are in the dark
The level banner no longer keeps its placeholder text after you load a save
The top of the screen no longer slides under the status bar after you turn the phone
The room description now floats over the whole screen instead of being squeezed above the action bar, so long descriptions are readable without scrolling inside a small box
Log message cards stay a little longer, and up to four can be on screen at once
New log messages now appear as cards under the header for a few seconds, so a message can be read as it arrives instead of only counted by the badge
The room you are standing in is named in the top bar, and tapping it shows the description
The room description opens by itself the first time you stand somewhere, and closes again on the next thing you do
The floating log button no longer covers the save button in the footer
A phone turned sideways now shows the map full screen: map on the left, its controls and the selected sector on the right
The map fills the space it is given instead of a measured height, so it no longer opens at 198px on a sideways phone
Opening the game on the map tab no longer ends in the "you've found a bug" popup
The map tab gives the whole screen to the map: no level banner, no stats block, tabs at the top
Sector details are a panel over the map that closes again, instead of a wall of text under it
Buttons that a tab change faded out can no longer stay hidden for the rest of the session
Building a camp or a beacon is done from the bar above the map instead of a table below the description
Whoever is in the sector, and the locales it leads on to, are rows of the bar too, so nothing situational has to be scrolled to
The gear stat icons have tooltips saying what they are; the text was already written and had nowhere to go
The log button stays reachable while the log is open on the exploration tab, so the log can be closed again
Sound effects reuse one audio element each instead of building a new one on every button, tab and log line
The log notification sound is aac rather than ogg, which Safari could not decode at all
The adventurer button is a small chip at the right of the level banner instead of a word in the stats
The adventurer button now works outside as well as in camp, where health and the gear numbers could not be read at all
The bucket and trap collect buttons stop showing a stale disabled state when you walk onto a sector that already has one
Compass directions no longer stack a letter to a line
Loading a save no longer sometimes throws an error popup over the loading screen
The tribe tab's camp overview is a card per camp on a phone instead of a twelve-column table, and none of its columns are dropped any more
Building a bucket or a trap is done from its chip in the bar above the map, not from a list further down the tab
The level title is pinned to the top of the screen instead of scrolling away, and takes about half the room it did
The Search actions moved into the bar above the map, so they never have to be scrolled to
Action buttons fit their labels instead of a fixed width, so "examine cracks" no longer runs out of its button
The empty band above the stats bar is gone
The version number can no longer be read from a stale copy of the changelog
The Go button on the embark page is no longer cut off the bottom of the screen and out of reach
Camp resource tooltips say how long until the store is full or empty
Perks and debuffs show in camp again, and an Adventurer button reveals health, vision and gear
The exploration tab leads with the sector figures as a table, then the description, then the actions
The version bar and the log button moved into the map panel, out of the scrolling page
The embark page no longer repeats its Go button at the end of the packing list
Tooltips near the bottom of the page no longer open behind the action bar and the map
The Build heading no longer goes out of step with the bucket and trap rows
The Search heading no longer lingers over an empty box when leaving a scouted sector
Offline play survives a version change instead of loading with no text
The bucket and trap icons are now actually blue and red rather than grey
The bucket and trap now really do fit on one row, and a new text label can no longer show up as its raw key after an update
The bucket and trap now show a blue or red resource icon, and both fit on one row above the map
Scavenge, scout, refill water and the bucket and trap collect actions moved into a bar above the map, so they never scroll away
Scout disappears once a sector is scouted, and a built bucket or trap shows its fill level and collect buttons instead of a build button
Mobile: fix the map and movement controls disappearing, and the footer opening the page instead of ending it
Mobile: the stats bar, the tab content and the map panel are one column the height of the screen, so no band can drift, be clipped, or be measured wrong
Mobile: fix the stats bar scrolling away and the map panel coming loose in the middle of the page - the page itself no longer scrolls, only the middle band does, so neither can detach
Mobile: the footer (save, restart, version) scrolls with the page instead of sitting after it, and "back to camp" clears the right edge

Mobile: the pinned map panel is about a third shorter - the compass, the map and "back to camp" sit side by side instead of stacked - and the perk icons share a row with the bag, so there is far more of the screen left to read the game in
Mobile: fix a bucket or trap appearing to be buildable in sectors that do not offer it, and the map panel appearing before scouting is unlocked
Mobile: the minimap is pinned to the bottom of the exploration tab instead of sitting at the end of it, and sector tooltips stay clear of the pinned header, tab bar and map
Mobile: the log button carries a badge with the number of unread entries, cleared when the drawer is opened
Mobile: fix the first row of tabs hiding behind the stats bar when the tabs wrap to more than one row, and give the wrapped rows room to breathe
Mobile: harden the collector cards and the exploration tab against the same inline-display problem, so the bucket and trap cannot silently fall back to the row that stranded their fill level
Mobile: fix the map panel stacking and filling the screen - jQuery writes an inline display when it shows the panel, and an inline style beat the rule that lays it out as a row
Mobile: the pinned stats bar, the scrolling page and the pinned map panel are separated by a bright rule and a shadow, so it is clear where one ends and the next begins - they were all the same tone

The game is a proper installable web app now: a service worker keeps it playable offline, and - the reason for it - the home screen app picks up new releases instead of holding an old copy of the page for days
Mobile: size both columns of the pinned map panel outright instead of from their content, so a scaled map cannot push the compass out of the row
Mobile: close the hairline between the info bar and the tab bar that the scrolling page showed through
Mobile: the pinned map panel is a non-wrapping row, so the compass can never end up underneath the map whatever the map measures
Mobile: the pinned minimap is scaled down so the compass always sits beside it rather than under it, at every phone width, and the panel takes a quarter of the screen instead of half
Mobile: the compass, enter camp and back to camp move into the pinned minimap panel, beside the map, and out of the scrolling middle of the exploration tab
Mobile: research and camp or collector upgrades ask first, with their cost, the same way crafting does. The plain sector scout does not - it is repeated too often for a confirm to help
Resource tooltips now end with the net rate - the sum of the credits and debits above it - in red when the store is draining. It was the one number the card never showed, on any layout
Mobile: fix the scrolling page painting over the stats bar while a stats tooltip was open

Fix rumours and reputation staying hidden in the header after you had earned some: the value was shown but its callout wrapper was left behind, because toggling the regular and mobile copies as one set silently skipped the wrapper
Mobile: scouting a sector now asks first too, alongside locales and workshops
Mobile: scouting a locale or a workshop asks first, the same way crafting does - a dialog with the cost, cancel only when you cannot afford it, cancel or scout when you can
Mobile: crafting no longer uses tooltip cards. Tapping an item opens a dialog with its effect and required resources - cancel only when you cannot afford it, cancel or craft when you can
Mobile: portrait only for now - the manifest asks for a portrait lock, and a phone turned sideways gets a notice instead of the broken landscape layout

Mobile: tooltips are measured again once their costs and requirements have been filled in, are re-placed when the phone toolbars slide in and out, and are capped to the space available so a long one scrolls instead of losing its end

Mobile: the bucket and the trap are laid out as cards - name and fill level on one line, collect all / collect one / upgrade beneath - instead of a five-widget row that wrapped and left the fill level stranded under the build button
Mobile: fix debuff and status tooltips never opening - the halo that widened their tap target was attached to the chip's list item, which covered the target itself and swallowed every tap

Mobile: a tooltip that would run off the bottom of the screen, or under the pinned action bar, now opens above its button instead. Fractional resource amounts no longer break the value away from its total in the info bar.

Mobile: the game column no longer sits 15px right of centre, so panels stop bleeding off the right edge. Tapping a debuff, perk or resource chip opens its tooltip in iOS Safari. The log button no longer stretches down the screen while pressed.
Mobile: in landscape and on small tablets the game fills the screen instead of leaving the old log column's fifth empty
Home screen web app: new crisp icon set and manifest, and the game runs full screen with no browser chrome when launched from the iOS home screen

B asks to go back to camp (Enter confirms, Esc cancels); when camp is unreachable it shows the requirements. Fix hotkey badges missing from localized buttons (Enter camp, Go, passages, collect all, movement).
Mobile port: the game works on phones with touch callouts, map pan and pinch zoom, a scrollable tab bar, a log drawer, and touch-sized controls

Mobile compactness overhaul: dense two-row header, mobile type scale, camp view scales to screen width, callouts clamp to the viewport, log stays in its drawer, tighter tables and popups, bigger touch targets

Mobile: the info bar is a compact aligned grid, the tab bar is pinned below it and wraps to an indented overflow row instead of scrolling, and long single-action pages (leave camp, milestones, colony launch) repeat their main action at the top

Mobile: the pinned info bar is now a ruled grid of label-over-value cells, three columns in camp (evidence/rumours/stamina, storage/reputation/population, materials) and two outside (evidence/rumours, vision/stamina, bag and party). Fixes camp storage vanishing from the header after re-entering camp, blank labels caused by a broken text refresh, and stat limits missing on small screens
Mobile: a page's main action is pinned to the bottom of the screen instead of repeated at the top, clearing the phone's home indicator and browser chrome, with the log button lifted above it
Mobile: the exploration tab leads with its actions (compass, enter camp, scavenge) instead of the minimap, so the most-used controls in the game are reachable without scrolling
? opens settings with the hotkey list. Buttons with a hotkey show a small badge (hover-only on compact buttons).
Minimap tooltips: hover a minimap square or an off-map hint icon for sector details. New hotkeys: Shift-F/Shift-G collect 1 food/water, H refills water at a spring.
Tab number annotations sit in the tab corner; ENTER on the embark tab leaves the camp
Update page description with fork attribution
Number keys 1-9 select the visible tabs in order; tabs show the number. ENTER enters the camp or uses a passage in the current sector.
Map: mouse wheel zoom, click targets and icons scale with zoom, hover tooltip for sectors
Fix error when scouting greenhouse after discovering deity; fix map tooltip error when no sector is selected
